arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
transliteration: Izaa zul zilatil ardu zil zaalaha

translations.en.sahih: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
translations.en.pickthall: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
translations.en.yusufali: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila bumi digoncangkan dengan goncangan (yang dahsyat),

translations.en.sahih: And the earth discharges its burdens
translations.en.pickthall: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
translations.en.yusufali: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),
translations.id.indonesian: dan bumi telah mengeluarkan beban-beban berat (yang dikandung)nya,

translations.en.sahih: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
translations.en.pickthall: And man saith: What aileth her?
translations.en.yusufali: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-

translations.en.sahih: That Day, it will report its news
translations.en.pickthall: That day she will relate her chronicles,
translations.en.yusufali: On that Day will she declare her tidings:
translations.id.indonesian: pada hari itu bumi menceritakan beritanya,

translations.en.sahih: Because your Lord has commanded it.
translations.en.yusufali: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.
translations.id.indonesian: karena sesungguhnya Tuhanmu telah memerintahkan (yang sedemikian itu) kepadanya.

arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
transliteration: Yawma iziy yas durun naasu ash tatal liyuraw a'maalahum

translations.en.sahih: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
translations.en.pickthall: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
translations.en.yusufali: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari itu manusia ke luar dari kuburnya dalam keadaan bermacam-macam, supaya diperlihatkan kepada mereka (balasan) pekerjaan mereka,

arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
transliteration: Famaiy ya'mal mithqala zarratin khai raiy-yarah

translations.en.sahih: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
translations.en.pickthall: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,
translations.en.yusufali: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!
translations.id.indonesian: Barangsiapa yang mengerjakan kebaikan seberat dzarrahpun, niscaya dia akan melihat (balasan)nya.

arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ

translations.en.sahih: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
translations.en.pickthall: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.
translations.en.yusufali: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan barangsiapa yang mengerjakan kejahatan sebesar dzarrahpun, niscaya dia akan melihat (balasan)nya pula.
